\noindent\scriptsize Each cell is raw-library \AC, \PAC\ JIT O1, and \PAC\ C++ O3.  Entries are generation seconds above runtime microseconds per point; \PAC\ runtime shows coloured wall and black pure-evaluator ratios, or absolute time without an \AC\ reference. The \PAC\ entries use the compiled \texttt{external UFO/JSON SM} source; the \AC\ columns are the same matched external reference used by the built-in-SM table. Green/orange/red means below one/below two/at least two.  Summaries are \texttt{min|max|avg|med|sum}; \texttt{sum} compares paired totals. A \textbf{VALIDATION FAILED} marker means the same-point difference exceeds the tolerance recorded for that validation result.
\par\vspace{0.15em}
\paragraph{Settings.}
\noindent\scriptsize \path{docs/result_matrix.py} (\texttt{--color-accuracy nlc}) writes this table and its JSON cache. \AC\ uses the raw generated-library path \texttt{amplicol\_generate --library=create-raw} followed by \texttt{amplicol\_color\_library\_probe}, preserving NLC/full colour-order interferences. \PAC\ uses Rusticol double precision, batch size 64, output chunk size 128,  Stage-local inputs, ten Horner iterations, default CPE rounds, expanded optimization limits, SymJIT O1, and \texttt{--target-runtime 10} are used. Only C++ O3 generation is subject to the 15-minute compile cap.
\par\vspace{0.15em}
\paragraph{Fortran reference gaps.}
\noindent\scriptsize 1 completed \PAC\ cells have no direct Fortran colour reference because that path stops above two quark lines; they are shown as absolute timings.
\par\vspace{0.15em}
\paragraph{C++ O3 gaps.}
\noindent\scriptsize 31 optional cells were not run and 0 exceeded the 15-minute compile budget; completed \AC/JIT data remain shown.
